raw_segments.text: What would have happened if she had not hidden it just then, and if she had chanced to look
up at the skylight at the wrong moment, I do not know perhaps the end of this chapter
might have been quite different because, if she had glanced at the skylight, she would
certainly have been startled by what she would have seen.
She would have seen exactly the same face pressed against the glass, and peering in
at her, as it had peered in earlier in the evening when she had been talking to Ermingard.
